gold_grs_detail.title: Regarding Empanelment of Consultants for IT Projects in Government of Maharashtra.

product.answer: I couldn't find a GR on 9 May 2019 in the corpus. The 2021 GR (202103191753279311) cites it as 'शासन निर्णय क्रमांक मातंसं-०८०/४/२०१४ O/O मातंसं, दिनांक ०९/०५/२०१९' and states that detailed instructions on empanelment of six consultant agencies were issued under it, and that the 2021 GR amends those earlier resolutions.
